referenceSources.title: VW Golf 3 Kit Car beim Konzer Old- und Youngtimertreffen, 15.07.2012 - Fahrzeugbilder.de
referenceSources.description:
A yellow VW Golf 3 Kit Car stands prominently on a paved plaza in front of a bistro, its body covered in blue and green camouflage-style graphics and bold Liqui Moly branding. White racing wheels, a rear spoiler, and various sponsor decals—including AST Suspension, ADAC, and scala—highlight its competitive motorsport configuration. The license plate reads "TR DA3," and the names "H. Dingert" and "A. Dingert" appear on the side window.

Photographed on December 18, 2014, this vehicle was part of the Konzer Old- und Youngtimertreffen held on July 15, 2012. The event attracts enthusiasts of classic and youngtimer cars, showcasing meticulously prepared vehicles in a relaxed outdoor setting. Other vintage cars and attendees can be seen in the background, enjoying a sunny summer gathering dedicated to automotive history and performance.
